name: ScissorsShiv
note: The Detente's execution blade (ClassKnives.csv): one half of a pair of scissors taped into a 12 cm grip, the other half's finger loop sticking out on +Z near its lower end, the blade (10 cm) to +Y. Its sharpened side is +Z and its back -Z, so tip [0,1,0] and up [0,0,-1]. 25 cm. The origin is the middle of the taped grip. Markers: Tip, Edge (mid-blade), Pommel (the grip's end).
